integrity: Analytical spectral/resolvent and closed-form proof; accompanying NumPy checker supplies only finite-dimensional diagnostics. First-public source date is the original arXiv v1 posting date, not a journal or revision date.
scientific_limitations: Uniqueness is proved for positive injective Schatten p operators comparable in Loewner order; the unrestricted infinite-rank problem is not resolved. The derivative is proved on the range of the square root, a form core for inverse fractional powers under comparability. No independent mathematical priority review has been performed.
title: Local max-phase tomography of positive Schatten quasi-class operators
